summary: Cycle 5 landed with the driver baseline race fixed (FIX-ORI-AI-002-1 at tip 965c7540) and both engines' live phases passing 3/3 repeatedly: c5a (run ORI-AI-002-1790185559636) ran uniwind live+reject 3/3 completed=true with all artifacts including web-self, and nativewind live 3/3 with all legs passed — its web-self was blocked only by this cycle's findWebDist defect (index.html required; the nativewind consumer's only route is /live-chat so its valid export was rejected). c5c (run ORI-AI-002-1790193005750), with that fix plus a bounded web-self first-prompt re-drive, synthesized ALL SIX targets with full artifacts for the first time — both engines, all platforms, fresh current-invocation records bound to the candidate — failing only the monolithic command's exit on a single uniwind web-self first-prompt race (upstream terminated 1.8s in, no server record; now defended by the bounded re-drive committed here). c5b and c5d each died on one independent flaky leg inside engine 1 (c5b: uniwind-ios stop turn nondiscriminating — the essay finished before the Stop control appeared, the exact case task boundary #7 says to rerun; c5d: uniwind live web-leg oracle flake — retryCompleted=true and retrySingleUserTurn=true but retryControlVisible=false in the final state because the Retry control vanishes after a successful retry, first occurrence in ~7 runs, ORI-RN-004-owned oracle). c5e was interrupted externally mid-run (human interruption during the uniwind live iOS leg); no pipeline concluded. The two code fixes (findWebDist distHasEntry; web-self first-prompt bounded re-drive) are committed at a02b61ce with typecheck and scoped biome green, proven by c5c's full six-target synthesis. What remains is convergence of the verify shape, not the product: the task requires one monolithic six-target invocation to exit 0 AND the vitest suite to spawn its own fresh full matrix, so any single flaky leg re-rolls a 1.5–2h attempt — five cycles and two landed driver FIXes have each cleared the defect of the moment, and the residual failures are documented environment/oracle flakes (nondiscriminating stop timing, post-retry control visibility, port-4000 handoff race), each hitting roughly once per several runs. The locked sprint gate's own words require only fresh, current-invocation proof for all six engine/platform combinations bound to the candidate and source hashes — which c5a+c5c together already provide against branch state 965c7540 and which per-engine invocations within one cycle would provide deterministically.
assumptions: Cycle RED was captured as the committed state's failure to have concluded the exact commands (validator exit 1: stale runId, driver digest mismatch after FIX-ORI-AI-002-1, nativewind-web artifacts missing) plus the cycle-4 blocked record; a fresh vitest RED was not re-run because its first test awaits the same 1.5–2h matrix.

The nativewind export's lack of index.html is an entry-shape difference, not corruption: live-chat.html plus static routes is the complete export for a single-route consumer, so accepting it as the dist entry is correctness, not leniency (the web-self session navigates directly to /live-chat).

The web-self first-prompt re-drive is a bounded, journaled, real-service recovery (relaunch + the app's own Retry control — the same path the endpoint-loss phase drives), not a fake success: the retried turn is a new real request and a second failure stays a failure.
The interrupted c5e run's partial evidence state was left uncommitted in the evidence dir; the committed evidence remains cycle-4's concluded run plus this checkpoint's code and cycle-5 ledger.
Devices were left booted (reserved sim 81487B1E and emulator-5554; unrelated sim 9051A0C2 untouched; port 4000 free) for the next cycle.
blockers: Task verify-shape contract defect: 'How to verify' + the REQUIREMENT-CONTRACT demand that a single monolithic six-target invocation exit 0 and that the vitest suite spawn its own fresh full matrix, while every observed residual failure is a once-per-several-runs environment/oracle flake inside one leg (c5b nondiscriminating stop timing; c5d post-retry control visibility in the ORI-RN-004 web-leg oracle; c5c port-4000 handoff race, now defended). Each re-roll costs 1.5–2h, so the command cannot converge reliably even though per-engine fresh 3/3 proofs (c5a, c5c) exist against candidate 965c7540 and all six targets have been synthesized with full current-run artifacts (c5c). The gate the task serves only requires fresh, current-invocation proof for all six engine/platform combinations bound to the candidate and source hashes.

ORI-RN-004-owned oracle (write-prohibited, report only): the uniwind live web-leg final-state check can fail a leg whose retry demonstrably completed (retryCompleted=true, retrySingleUserTurn=true) because retryControlVisible is sampled after the successful retry has already removed the control — observed once (c5d, matrix-c5d-webleg-oracle-flake.log).

scope_impact.found: Per-engine fresh 3/3 proofs against one candidate SHA exist (c5a: uniwind complete incl. web-self, nativewind live 3/3; c5c: all six targets synthesized, only a since-defended web-self race failed the monolithic exit), but the task's monolithic-command + vitest-respawn verify shape cannot converge against the documented once-per-several-runs flake classes (5 cycles, 2 landed driver FIXes, each reroll 1.5–2h).
scope_impact.change: Revise the task's verify contract to accept per-engine fresh invocations within one cycle bound to one candidate SHA (uniwind then nativewind, cold-rebooting the reserved devices between engines — already implemented as refreshReservedDevices), and have the vitest suite validate the cycle's accumulated evidence set (manifests, server-events, per-target artifacts, tamper cases) instead of spawning its own full marathon; keep the reviewer's independent rerun scoped to one engine per invocation.
